items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: I didn't know he was still living. Did you mean happy? No, I don't think it would be happy. Wasn't red happy? It was a red happy.

ctx.x: Is he still around? Yeah. If it's the same cook, cause that's the only cookshop son I know. That's what we used to call him. I didn't know he was still living. Did you mean happy? No, I don't think it would be happy.
It wouldn't be happy ghost and... Yeah, cause he, I know he's, he's still playing. Black happy, he plays in the Eureka. Yeah.
Wasn't red happy? It was a red happy.
